name: Exp_DigitalF-T01
summary: This EA trades based on crossover signals from the custom DigitalF-T01 indicator, which outputs two oscillator lines. It opens buy positions when oscillator 1 crosses above oscillator 2 and sell positions on the opposite crossover, with configurable stop loss and take profit levels.
summary_zh: 该EA基于自定义DigitalF-T01指标的双线交叉信号进行交易。当振荡器1上穿振荡器2时开多仓，反之开空仓，并配有可配置的止损止盈水平。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是基于自定义数字滤波器指标DigitalF-T01的双线交叉信号进行趋势跟踪交易。入场条件为：当Osc1在上一根K线上穿Osc2时（Osc1[1]>Osc2[1]且Osc1[0]<Osc2[0]），产生买入信号；当Osc1下穿Osc2时，产生卖出信号。出场条件包括反向交叉信号触发平仓以及固定点数的止损和止盈。仓位管理通过MM参数控制，支持手数模式和保证金比例模式两种资金管理方式。策略使用了新K线检测机制（IsNewBar），确保每个K线周期只计算一次信号，避免重复交易。指标使用了半通道参数（halfchanel=25）和多种应用价格类型，增强信号灵活性。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is trend following based on crossover signals from the custom DigitalF-T01 digital filter indicator with two oscillator lines. Entry conditions: a buy signal is generated when Osc1 crosses above Osc2 (Osc1[1]>Osc2[1] and Osc1[0]<Osc2[0] on the signal bar), and a sell signal on the opposite crossover. Exit conditions include closing positions on reverse crossover signals and fixed stop loss (1000 points) and take profit (2000 points) levels. Position sizing is controlled via the MM parameter supporting both lot-based and margin-based money management modes. The strategy employs a new bar detection mechanism (IsNewBar) to ensure signals are calculated only once per bar, preventing duplicate trades. The indicator uses a half-channel parameter (halfchanel=25) and multiple applied price types for signal flexibility.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description: 资金管理参数，控制仓位大小
parameters.description_en: Money management parameter for lot calculation

parameters.name: MMMode
parameters.description: 手数计算模式（手数或保证金比例）
parameters.description_en: Lot mode: free margin / balance / margin after loss / balance after loss / fixed lot

pros: 使用新K线检测机制，避免同一K线内重复开仓，减少无效交易
提供完整的买入/卖出开仓和平仓开关，交易方向控制灵活
止损止盈参数可配置，具备基本的风险控制框架
支持多种价格类型输入，指标信号可适配不同市场特征
使用数字滤波器指标，信号平滑度较好，可减少噪音干扰
pros_en: New bar detection mechanism prevents duplicate trades within the same bar, reducing invalid entries
Complete buy/sell open and close switches provide flexible control over trading directions
Configurable stop loss and take profit parameters provide a basic risk control framework
Supports multiple applied price types, allowing signal adaptation to different market characteristics
Digital filter indicator provides smoothed signals, reducing market noise interference
cons: 止损1000点和止盈2000点数值较大，在波动较小的品种上可能不适合
缺少点差过滤机制，在宽点差品种上可能产生不利入场
依赖自定义指标DigitalF-T01，指标逻辑不透明，难以验证信号有效性
没有移动止损或追踪止损机制，盈利头寸可能大幅回撤
缺少最大持仓数量和总风险暴露限制，多信号同时触发时风险集中
cons_en: Stop loss of 1000 points and take profit of 2000 points are large values that may not suit low-volatility instruments
No spread filter mechanism, potentially leading to unfavorable entries on wide-spread instruments
Depends on custom DigitalF-T01 indicator whose logic is opaque, making signal validity hard to verify
No trailing stop mechanism, meaning profitable positions may experience significant drawdowns
No maximum position count or total risk exposure limit, concentrating risk when multiple signals trigger simultaneously
improvements: 增加点差过滤条件，当点差超过阈值时暂停开仓，避免不利入场成本
增加移动止损/追踪止损功能，在趋势延续时锁定更多利润
增加最大同时持仓数量限制和账户风险暴露上限控制
improvements_en: Add a spread filter to pause opening positions when spread exceeds a threshold, avoiding unfavorable entry costs
Add a trailing stop feature to lock in more profits as the trend continues
Add maximum simultaneous position count limits and account risk exposure caps

risk_points: 止损1000点较大，单笔亏损可能占账户较大比例
缺少点差过滤，高波动时段滑点可能显著
无最大持仓限制，连续信号可能导致过度集中风险
risk_points_en: Stop loss of 1000 points is large, single trade loss could represent a significant portion of the account
No spread filter, slippage during high volatility periods could be significant
No maximum position limit, consecutive signals could lead to over-concentrated risk exposure
